_fixture_note: MOCK Jira fixture used for exploratory testing (second scenario: composite key, inner join lookup, XLSX/JSON sources).
description:
Build DAILY_SALES from order_lines and products.

Acceptance Criteria
AC1: SALE_DATE and PRODUCT_CODE together form the business key of DAILY_SALES.
AC2: PRODUCT_NAME is copied as-is from products.PRODUCT_NAME.
AC3: Only order lines with QTY > 0 are included.
AC4: TOTAL_QTY = SUM(QTY) per SALE_DATE, PRODUCT_CODE.
AC5: GROSS_REVENUE = SUM(QTY * UNIT_PRICE) per SALE_DATE, PRODUCT_CODE, rounded to 2 decimals.
AC6: INNER JOIN order_lines to products on PRODUCT_CODE.
AC7: PRODUCT_CODE cannot be null.
